pieces.Text: At 9th level, as a move action, a shielded fighter may make a combat maneuver check to use his shield to impede an adjacent enemy. If successful, the target suffers a -2 penalty on its attack rolls against the shielded fighter and a -2 penalty to AC on attacks made by the shielded fighter until the beginning of his next turn. At 13th level, a shielded fighter may use this ability as a swift action. This ability replaces weapon training 2 and 3.
